pure_negative_rule: truth_fog_fraction == 0; do not overweight mixed onset/recovery windows
mining_rule: Pure training negatives whose participant-held-out mining score >= 0.30 receive weight 2; every other training row has weight 1
nested_rule: Every inner validation participant is excluded from the mining subfolds AND weighted fit; outer test participants are excluded at all training stages
diagnostic_rule: Use first frozen outer fold TRAINING participants only; activity truth may stratify diagnostics but is never a runtime gate or mining input
runtime_rule: Same sensor-only RF inference; no activity or FoG truth required
selection_policy: One fixed weighting candidate, same data and threshold rule as RF comparison; no automatic default replacement or test-tuned weight search
evaluation_scope: Further exploratory analysis of the same previously inspected cohort, not a new independent external validation
